description: Plots functions, points and curves on labelled coordinate axes.

examples.label: Example 1
examples.code:
<tp-xy-plot label="Functions">
    <script type="tp/xy-plot">
label = "Functions"
x-axis = [-10, 10]
y-axis = [-5, 5]
curve Sine = function(x, 2*sin(x))
curve Line = function(x, x/2)
</script>
  </tp-xy-plot>

attributes.name: grid
attributes.description: Visible grid directions; overrides the graph directive when present.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Title displayed at the left of the view toolbar.

attributes.name: settings
attributes.description: Shows interactive settings below the graph and its controls.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: URL of a text file containing the XY graph definition; used instead of the inline tp/xy-plot script.

methods.name: anim(): string
methods.description: With no argument, returns the reveal sequence as text (JSON for grouped steps). With names, replaces it from comma-separated names, JSON or a step array; the setter returns no value.

methods.name: anim(names: string | XYAnimationStep[]): void
methods.description: With no argument, returns the reveal sequence as text (JSON for grouped steps). With names, replaces it from comma-separated names, JSON or a step array; the setter returns no value.

methods.name: anim(names?: string | XYAnimationStep[]): string | undefined
methods.description: With no argument, returns the reveal sequence as text (JSON for grouped steps). With names, replaces it from comma-separated names, JSON or a step array; the setter returns no value.

methods.name: applyDefinition(): void
methods.description: Applies the definition draft and reports errors without replacing the last valid graph.

methods.name: closeZoom(): void
methods.description: Closes the enlarged graph.

methods.name: exportSvg(): string
methods.description: Exports the displayed graph with its current viewport, visibility and theme colors.

methods.name: goToEnd(): void
methods.description: Reveals all objects in the reveal sequence.

methods.name: goToStart(): void
methods.description: Hides all objects in the reveal sequence.

methods.name: loadFile(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Chooses and validates a graph definition file. Requires a user gesture in browsers that restrict file dialogs.

methods.name: next(): void
methods.description: Reveals the next object; stops at the end.

methods.name: openFiles(): void
methods.description: Opens or closes the graph definition files menu.

methods.name: openZoom(): void
methods.description: Opens the enlarged graph dialog.

methods.name: previous(): void
methods.description: Hides the last revealed object; stops at the start.

methods.name: redo(): void
methods.description: Restores the next graph definition.

methods.name: reset(): void
methods.description: Restores the initially loaded graph and its settings.

methods.name: resetSource(): void
methods.description: Restores the definition draft from the displayed graph.

methods.name: resetZoom(): void
methods.description: Restores the original graph viewport.

methods.name: save(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Saves the definition draft to its current file or asks for a destination.

methods.name: saveAs(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Asks for a destination and saves the graph definition draft.

methods.name: setData(data: TpXYPlotData): void
methods.description: Renders numeric series with automatic axis ranges; separate series preserve gaps.

methods.name: toggleEditorToolbar(): void
methods.description: Shows or hides the graph definition editor toolbar.

methods.name: toggleSource(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Shows or hides the graph definition.

methods.name: toggleZoomSource(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Shows or hides the definition in the enlarged graph.

methods.name: undo(): void
methods.description: Restores the preceding graph definition.

methods.name: zoomIn(): void
methods.description: Increases the graph viewport magnification.

methods.name: zoomOut(): void
methods.description: Decreases the graph viewport magnification.

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-xy-plot>` element plots functions, points and curves on labelled coordinate axes.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| :tp-icon:{name="plus" library="tp" size="2em"} :tp-icon:{name="minus" library="tp" size="2em"} Zoom in (+) / Zoom out (−) | Magnify or widen the coordinate ranges around the graph center, in both the preview and enlarged view. Keep the current animation step. |
| :tp-icon:{name="save-image" size="2em"} Save image | Save the current graph view as SVG, PNG or WebP, with its visible axes, grid, animation step and theme colors. |
| :tp-icon:{name="theme-light-dark" size="2em"} Theme | Choose Light, Dark or Auto for this plot only; the enlarged view shares the same theme. |
| Code (`</>`) | Replace the curves with Graph definition, or return to the curves, in either view. Draft edits are preserved; Play applies them. Closing zoom restores the previous normal view. |
| :tp-icon:{name="redo" library="tp" size="2em"} :tp-icon:{name="undo" library="tp" size="2em"} Undo / Redo | Undo or redo an applied definition change (Play, file load, interactive settings or Reset). A new change clears the redo history. View navigation is independent. |
| Drag the graph (mouse or touch) | Move the drawing horizontally and vertically. Center a point of interest before zooming in. |
| Settings fields | Update the graph and enlarged view; invalid entries retain the last valid graph and show feedback. |
| Start / Previous / Next / End | Return to zero revealed objects, hide the last revealed object, reveal the next object, or reveal all objects. The counter shows the current step and total. |
| Graph definition | Expand or collapse the editable source in the code view, with or without settings. |
| Graph definition > Files | Load a `.txt` definition, Save the draft, or Save as a new file. Valid loads update the graph and settings; invalid files preserve the current graph. |
| Graph definition > F1 / Reset definition / Play | Toggle the editor toolbar / discard draft edits and restore the displayed graph definition / validate and apply the edited definition. |
| Reset | Restore the original graph definition and settings. |
| Zoom graph (outward arrows) | Open the enlarged graph. |
| Close zoomed graph (inward arrows) | Close the enlarged graph and return to the preview. |
| :tp-icon:{name="code" library="tp" size="2em"} Show graph definition | Show graph definition. |
| :tp-icon:{name="zoom-out" library="tp" size="2em"} Zoom graph | Zoom graph. |
| :tp-icon:{name="zoom-in" library="tp" size="2em"} Close zoomed graph | Close zoomed graph. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Move between the available controls. |
| <kbd>F1</kbd> in Graph definition | Show or hide the source editor toolbar. |
| <kbd>ArrowUp</kbd> / <kbd>ArrowDown</kbd>, <kbd>Home</kbd> / <kbd>End</kbd> in the file menu | Navigate Load, Save and Save as; <kbd>Enter</kbd>/<kbd>Space</kbd> activates an action and <kbd>Escape</kbd> closes the menu. |
| <kbd>Enter</kbd> / <kbd>Space</kbd> | Activate the focused button, including Code, Undo, Redo, Zoom in, Zoom out and Reset. |
| <kbd>←</kbd>/<kbd>↑</kbd>/<kbd>→</kbd>/<kbd>↓</kbd> on the focused graph | Move the drawing in the arrow direction by 10% of the visible range. |
| <kbd>Home</kbd> on the focused graph | Restore the original scale and position. |
| <kbd>Escape</kbd> | Close the enlarged graph. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
